$comment: Hand-authored notes for InitialRequest.html. Merged into the per-form Markdown by review/tools/render-fields.js. Never overwritten by extract-fields.js. `effect` = what the value causes downstream (routing, task creation, email content). Descriptive only — no findings. Fields with no entry render as 'not yet documented'.

dateRequested.effect: Stored as Date Requested; shown in the dashboard Date Requested column.

requesterEmail.effect: Becomes the workflow initiator. Grants that person ROLE_REQUESTER (tier 6) — cancel and remind rights on this request. Receives every status email.

requesterName.effect: Stored; shown as Requester on the dashboard and in the step tracker.

hireDate.effect: Stored as Hire Date and shown as Start Date on the dashboard. Part of the duplicate-submission key (name + hire date). Drives the 'Add Start Date to Calendar' link in the ID Setup emails. Changing it at HR Verification notifies Safety and ID Setup.

hireType.effect: Stored as New Hire/Rehire. A rehire may carry an existing Internal Employee ID, which is validated as 4–6 digits before anything is written.
hireType.label: New Hire or Rehire

employeeType.effect: Stored as Employee Type; shown in the Emp Type dashboard column.
employeeType.label: Employee Type

employmentType.effect: ROUTING. Combined with System Access: Hourly + System Access=No completes the workflow at HR Verification and never reaches IT. Also decides when the Safety task is created — at ID Setup on the hourly path, after HR Verification otherwise.
employmentType.label: Employment Type

firstName.effect: Half the employee name used for the workflow record, emails, task titles and the duplicate-submission key. Also seeds the DSS username as first.last at ID Setup.

lastName.effect: As firstName — name, dedupe key and DSS username seed.

position.effect: Stored as Position Title; appears in specialist task descriptions and emails. Changing it at HR Verification notifies Safety and ID Setup.

siteName.effect: Stored as Site Name; shown in the dashboard Site column and carried into Safety and ID Setup context. Changing it at HR Verification notifies Safety.

jobSiteNumber.effect: Stored as Job Site #. New-hire only — hidden, un-required and disabled in equipment mode.

department.effect: Stored; carried into the workflow context block on emails.

managerEmail.effect: Becomes the assignee of the WIS Assignment task and grants that person ROLE_MANAGER (tier 7). Shown on the dashboard and used for the My Open Requests panel.

managerName.effect: Stored; shown in emails and the request header.

systemAccess.effect: ROUTING. Answering No clears the systems and equipment lists before they are written, and combined with Hourly ends the workflow at HR Verification. Also reveals the systems/equipment section when Yes.
systemAccess.label: Needs System Access?

systems.effect: CREATES TASKS. 'BOSS' inserts the IT Confirmation step before IT Setup. 'Fleetio' creates the Fleet task. 'SiteDocs' creates the ID Setup task on equipment requests only — on a new hire the SiteDocs account is made during ID Setup. 'Google Account' reveals the Google account fields. Stored as a comma-separated list.
systems.label: Systems / Apps

adpSalaryAccess.effect: When Yes, the Payroll notification sent after HR Verification carries an explicit salary-access callout.
adpSalaryAccess.label: ADP Salary Access

bossTrainingOnly.effect: Changes the WIS task wording to training modules only, explicitly excluding committee, cost sheet, trip reports and grievances.
bossTrainingOnly.label: BOSS Training User Only

bossCostSheet.effect: Stored as a BOSS detail; becomes an IT checklist line. Reveals the cost sheet job numbers picker when Yes.
bossCostSheet.label: BOSS Cost Sheet

bossTripReports.effect: Stored as a BOSS detail; becomes an IT checklist line.
bossTripReports.label: BOSS Trip Reports

bossGrievance.effect: Stored as BOSS Grievances; becomes an IT checklist line.
bossGrievance.label: BOSS Grievances

bossJobSites.effect: Built at load from reference data. Stored as the BOSS job sites list.
bossJobSites.label: BOSS Job Sites

costSheetJobNumbers.effect: Built at load from reference data. Stored as the BOSS cost sheet job list; only meaningful when Cost Sheet is Yes.
costSheetJobNumbers.label: BOSS Cost Sheet Job Numbers

googleEmailLocal.effect: The requested mailbox name. Combined with the domain it seeds the SiteDocs username default at ID Setup, and IT confirms or changes it at IT Setup.

googleDomain.effect: The requested domain, combined with the local part above.

equipment.effect: CREATES TASKS. 'Business Cards' creates the Business Cards task. 'SiteDocs Tablet' counts toward the SiteDocs indicator on the dashboard. Everything else becomes IT provisioning checklist lines. Stored as a comma-separated list.
equipment.label: Equipment

computerRequestType.effect: New or reassigned. Chooses which computer detail block is shown, and becomes an IT checklist line.
computerRequestType.label: Computer Request Type

computerType.effect: Stored; IT checklist detail for a new machine.
computerType.label: Computer Type

computerPreviousUser.effect: Stored; IT checklist detail for a reassigned machine.

computerPreviousType.effect: Stored; IT checklist detail for a reassigned machine.

computerSerialNumber.effect: Stored; IT checklist detail for a reassigned machine.

creditCardUSA.effect: CREATES A TASK. Any of the three card boxes creates the Finance task; this one adds the USA card line with its requested limit.
creditCardUSA.label: USA Credit Card

creditCardLimitUSA.effect: Requested monthly limit, quoted on the USA line of the Finance task. Falls back to 'Standard' when blank.

creditCardCanada.effect: CREATES A TASK. Adds the Canada card line to the Finance task.
creditCardCanada.label: Canada Credit Card

creditCardLimitCanada.effect: Requested monthly limit for the Canada card; 'Standard' when blank.

creditCardHomeDepot.effect: CREATES A TASK. Adds the Home Depot card line to the Finance task.
creditCardHomeDepot.label: Home Depot Credit Card

creditCardLimitHomeDepot.effect: Requested monthly limit for the Home Depot card; 'Standard' when blank.

phoneRequestType.effect: New or reassigned. Chooses which phone detail block is shown; becomes an IT checklist line. The number is also reused on termination to build the phone suspension line.
phoneRequestType.label: Mobile Phone Request Type

phonePreviousUser.effect: Stored; IT checklist detail for a reassigned phone.

phonePreviousNumber.effect: Stored; IT checklist detail for a reassigned phone.

jrRequired.effect: Whether a JR title applies. Reveals the JR picker when Yes.
jrRequired.label: JR Title Required?

jrAssignment.effect: The chosen JR title. Carried into HR Verification, where it is combined with the job title on the verification record.

plan306090.effect: CREATES TWO TASKS. Yes creates the 30/60/90 Review task for the review group AND a separate JR Title task for the JR group — different assignees, closed independently. Suppressed on equipment requests. The 30/60/90 task blocks completion; the JR Title task does not.
plan306090.label: 30/60/90 Day Plan

jonasJobNumbers.effect: CREATES A TASK. Built at load from reference data. Any value creates the Purchasing task, with one checklist line per job number. Stored comma-separated.
jonasJobNumbers.label: Jonas Job Numbers

purchasingSites.effect: CREATES A TASK. Built at load from reference data. Any value creates the Purchasing task (combined with Jonas job numbers if both are set), with one line per site.
purchasingSites.label: Central Purchasing Sites

adpSites.effect: Built at load from reference data. Stored as the ADP sites list; revealed when ADP is among the systems.
adpSites.label: ADP Sites

comments.effect: Stored as Comments; carried into the context block on downstream emails.

notes.effect: Present on the page but not included in the submitted payload.
